Hmm, but wait. What about the same zone having two entries that differ only in owner case, e.g. "A.Test." and "a.test."? Both canonicalize to "a.test." → same owner ✓ handled since I canonicalize before grouping.

```python
def read_input():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_INPUT_BYTES:

                remaining -= len(chunk)
```
